validity.researcher_notes: FGT's South Alabama Project is Docket No. CP18-530-000 (prior notice filed 2018-07-19 under FGT's blanket certificate). The Federal Register notice describes it as authorization to 'construct/modify, own, maintain and operate, certain natural gas mainline facilities and appurtenances in Santa Rosa County, Florida, and modify an existing delivery point, in Escambia County, Alabama' providing up to 60,000 MMBtu/d of firm transportation to two shippers -- a delivery-point/mainline-facility modification under a blanket certificate, not a new pipeline segment. 60,000 MMBtu/d is consistent (within the expected MMBtu-vs-MMcf rounding) with the sheet's recorded Capacity=60.00 MMcf/d, and the sheet's LengthKnownKm is already correctly 0.00 -- both point the same way. Per standing rule 'expansion with no new physical pipe -> LengthKnown=0, Diameter=blank', the blank Diameter is the correct value, not an omission. I searched EIA's pipeline projects table and Alabama PSC/ADEM for a second independent source specific to THIS project and found none discussing it by name (distinct from the Southwest Alabama Project II record, which is a different docket/compressor unit covered on P4060) -- single source, so tier is medium, not high. StartYear1=2018 on the sheet matches the docket's 2018 filing/authorization year.
